name: NexoWatt EOS Admin
fixes: force cache refresh for all EOS branding/runtime assets after every package update
keep source and deployed branding assets byte-identical so a future frontend build does not restore stale UI code
remove the hidden native drawer header without attaching listeners or injecting content into that hidden node
replace old heavyweight ObjectBrowser and adapter-react bundles with compatibility shims to the single active v61 runtime
keep only one effective React-DnD/HTML5 backend on fresh loads and reduce the update package size
extend package validation to detect cache-tag, source/build, nested-version and compatibility-shim regressions
preserve native datapoint semantics and the existing deletion/version-selection protections
notes: Consistency hardening after v63. The top-left ghost header remains hidden; the independent EOS navigation toggle remains available.
description: Hardens cache invalidation, source/build parity and the single active frontend runtime without changing native ioBroker datapoint write semantics.
